response.sql: SELECT AVG(patient_hemoglobin_avg) as avg_hemoglobin, AVG(patient_appt_minus_pt_avg) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_hemoglobin_avg, AVG(APPT - PT) as patient_appt_minus_pt_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID) subquery

alternatives.interpretation: The phrase "average of APPT minus PT" could mean (average of APPT) minus (average of PT) rather than the average of their difference; computed as AVG(APPT) - AVG(PT)
